surface-1.$description: Cards, panels, table rows. Default ground for text.

surface-2.$description: Sunken areas: inputs, track of meters, table headers.

line.$description: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

line-strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons). 3:1 on surface-1 in both themes.

ink.$description: Primary text on surface-0/1/2. 14:1+ in both themes.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, labels, timestamps. 6:1+ on surface-0/1.

brand.$description: Aurora teal. Primary actions, links, selected states. Text on surface-1 passes 6:1.

brand-strong.$description: Hover/pressed for brand; text on brand-soft.

brand-soft.$description: Selected rows, brand tints, quiet highlights.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on a brand fill.

dawn.$description: First light. Brand moments only (logo, cover, hero). Never a status colour, never text.

dawn-soft.$description: Warm tint for onboarding and empty states.

critical.$description: Critical patient status, destructive actions, errors. Text on surface-1 and critical-soft.

critical-soft.$description: Background of critical alerts and pills.

warning.$description: Under observation, values approaching limits. Text on surface-1 and warning-soft.

warning-soft.$description: Background of warning pills and banners.

stable.$description: Stable patient, values in range, success. Text on surface-1 and stable-soft.

info.$description: Neutral information: discharge pending, scheduled, transfers.

info-soft.$description: Background of info pills and banners.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px offset.

shadow-raised.$description: Menus, popovers, the critical alert banner.
